name: Pathao Courier
coverage: 64 districts; home delivery stated in every district.
codSupport: Yes — 0.5% COD charge inside Dhaka Metropolitan City, 1% outside Dhaka City.
pricing: Same city (24h) BDT 60–90; suburbs (72h) BDT 80–130; inter-city Dhaka (72h) BDT 110–170; outside Dhaka (72h) BDT 120–180. Extra charge above 2 kg.
api: Not stated on the courier page; merchants integrate through the merchant panel.
applicationPath: Register at merchant.pathao.com/register with business name, owner name, mobile and email, then add store and payout details.
notes: Publishes both a rate range and the COD percentage, which most couriers here do not. Rate bands vary by weight — confirm your own weight class.

name: Paperfly
coverage: Same city, periphery/suburb and rest of Bangladesh. Parcels up to 8 kg.
codSupport: Yes — 0% COD charge for same-city delivery, 1% for periphery/suburb and rest of Bangladesh, on the collected amount.
pricing: Standard up to 1 kg: BDT 70 same city, BDT 110 periphery/suburb, BDT 130 rest of Bangladesh. BDT 20 per additional kg. Charges include VAT and tax.
returnHandling: No additional return charge — only one attempted delivery charge applies. Exchange and partial delivery add 50% of the delivery charge on top of one forward charge.
applicationPath: Register through the Paperfly site, then use the merchant panel.
notes: The only courier here that publishes rate, COD percentage and return terms together. Free returns matter more than the headline rate once you are running COD at scale.

name: eCourier
coverage: Inside Dhaka, outside Dhaka metro, and thana/union areas.
codSupport: Yes — COD reconciliation, reporting and settlement listed on both plans.
pricing: Inside Dhaka next-day standard (24–48h) BDT 80; outside Dhaka metro (3–4 days) BDT 130; outside Dhaka thana/union (5–7 days) BDT 160.
returnHandling: NDR (non-delivery report) management listed on both the Standard and Express plans.
api: Express plan only — the Standard plan lists no API access.
applicationPath: Sign up from the pricing page; the Express plan states a two-month minimum signup period.
notes: Publishes a plan comparison rather than a single rate card. If you need API access or multi-pickup addresses, those sit on the paid Express tier.

name: Steadfast Courier
codSupport: Yes — the site states it collects cash on behalf of the merchant.
pricing: Not publicly stated; the site offers a price calculator instead of a rate card.
applicationPath: Sign up as a merchant on steadfast.com.bd.
notes: Claims 300k registered merchants and unlimited daily pickup. Get the rate from the calculator or your account manager before comparing with the couriers that publish one.

name: REDX
api: Yes — an open developer API for parcel creation, pickup stores and tracking, plus WordPress and Shopify integrations, with a sandbox environment.
notes: The RedX site renders entirely in the browser, so its pages could not be read directly on the verification date — the coverage and API details here come from the indexed official pages. Confirm rates and COD terms in the merchant panel.

name: S.A. Paribahan
coverage: 64 districts, 120+ branches and 8 divisional hubs; international hubs in Malaysia and Singapore.
pricing: Not publicly stated; the site directs visitors to request a quote.
api: Yes — corporate API integration for connecting an e-commerce store is advertised.
applicationPath: Request a quote through the S.A. Paribahan site.
notes: Branch-and-cargo network with an e-commerce express service on top, rather than an e-commerce-first merchant platform. Useful for bulk and heavy consignments.

name: Sundarban Courier Service
coverage: 600+ outlets, with 160 branches and agency offices nationwide.
codSupport: Collects the value-declared amount against e-commerce and condition parcels through its branch network.
api: Not publicly stated; a customer portal exists at customer.sundarbancourierltd.com.
applicationPath: Contact through the customer portal or the 16214 hotline.
notes: The oldest and widest branch network of the couriers here. Strong where a customer will collect from a counter; weaker as a doorstep e-commerce workflow.
